environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with default task networking. Container runs with default Linux capabilities. Service is in a VPC subnet with access to the instance metadata service (IMDS v1 enabled on the task role endpoint at 169.254.170.2 and credential endpoint). DNS resolution is handled by the VPC resolver at 169.250.0.2. No network policy restricts outbound traffic from the container. The attacker controls an external DNS server that can respond with different IPs for the same hostname (short TTL).
